Cold.name: Cold
Cold.description:
❄️ Feelings stay behind glass. You decide with your head and show nothing.

🧊 Threats, tears and pleas do not move you, and you watch everything.
⚠️ People find you unreadable and unsettling, and few get close.
⚠️ You miss what people feel until it is too late.
🔀 If you are also Kind-Hearted, the warmth shows only in what you do, never on your face.

📈 Grants: Surveillance +5
Cold.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is cold: they keep their feelings hidden, decide with their head and show little; threats, tears and pleas do not move them, and they watch everything. Weakness: people find them unreadable and unsettling, few get close, and they miss what others feel until it is too late. If the character is also Kind-Hearted, the warmth shows only in actions. The narrator shows what others feel; what the character feels is the player's decision.
